passages.text:
Hey all,
I invited most of you (apologies if some were not invited.. Adam / Amy, pls let me know if you want to join. Call is on
Monday at 1pm est.to follow up withspecific questions. Below,are the questions Iput forward.
Chris - also tagging you if you want to join. The mission in Malawi just reached out with a rather urgent issue. I can
forward you the note. But more if you're free and would like to join!
Below are the questions. I'd welcome you asking them. Thx! Vera
• Moldova: Now that our vetted organizations are in your trusted partner program, what does
this mean? Is there a POC for them? Do they get priority escalation? Will you be
monitoring and/or addressing any issues that arise in any specific way? Are you open to
them surfacing local insights that they see as they relate to disinformation, online abuse,
and /or other issues?
• Elections: Can you please share anything about upcoming global elections for 2023 and
2024 you are preparing in, specifically in countries where USAID operates in (developing
nations)? Can you comment at all on your plans to address them?
• In a previous exchange between Administrator Power and Nick Clegg, the topic of building
resilience to address disinformation has come up. We understand you have had some pilot
initiatives in Europe. Are there any lessons learned from these activities that you can share,
and is this something you hope to scale to other developing markets?
• Bulgaria and Slovakia:
• What is the role of Telus in Bulgaria? What languages does it monitor content in?
• In Slovakia, what is the most effective way for the government and civil society to voice
their concerns so they are heard by Meta?
Vera Zakem
Chief Digital Democracy and Rights Officer
USAID
[contact omitted]
